newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares hit new peaks, Nycomed dominates.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares hit new peaks, Nycomed dominates.

text.p: Norwegian share trading on Wednesday remained dominated by drugs group Nycomed ASA, which continued to rise on the back of merger plans with Britain's Amersham International Plc.
Nycomed made new year highs in heavy trade, the A share peaking at 139.50 crowns but closing almost five percent up at 139 crowns. The B stock advanced two crowns to 132 crowns.
Turnover in the Oslo-based company accounted for 686 million crowns of the bourse's total turnover of 1.51 billion crowns.
Dealers said underlying market sentiment was positive despite a recent sharp rise in domestic short-term interest rates and lackluster activity -- discounting Nycomed -- due to the summer holidays.
Few sellers were seen out in the market, they said.
The Total share index ran up to a new all-time high at 1216.98 points near the close before slipping back to end at 1216.72 points, a gain of 0.95 percent.
